## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Cancels the behavior of [Start Forcing Player Position](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/start%2Bforcing%2Bplayer%2Bposition) for the specified player or players. Regular movement will resume from the last forced position(s).

## Snippet

```
Stop Forcing Player Position(Event Player);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Player_==

> ==**Player**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The player or players whose positions will stop being forced.
````
